arStrings.szText:
A dark aura surrounds you, inflicting {c_important}Decrepify{/c} and {c_important}Iron Maiden{/c} on enemies who touch it. 

{c_important}Curses{/c} inflicted this way spread to surrounding targets every {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1|]{/c} seconds and last {c_number}[Affix_Value_2]{/c} seconds outside of the aura.
